steps.content: After the press conference ends, a group of satisfied reporters exit the venue, seemingly having obtained the materials for tomorrow's headlines. In their conversations, they mention Fortuna and a certain lawyer.

steps.speaker: Reporter A
steps.content: I didn't expect the lawyer that Fortuna wanted to hire for their defense to be so upright and inflexible. He flatly refused to accept Fortuna's defense materials. Seeing the furious expressions of the staff talking to him, even I feel scared.

steps.speaker: Reporter B
steps.content: This lawyer seems to be quite a tough character... although he's not very well-known.
You hear sounds of smashing and shouting from the back alley of the building. There's a vaguely familiar voice, a male voice.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: Tsk! You lowly lawyer! We even prepared the evidence for you, how are those reporters not taken care of?!
These "evidences," are clearly forged, don't embarrass yourself.
As you approach, you realize it's Mr. Fox. He's cornered in the alley by Fortuna's staff, unable to escape.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: Evil begets evil. False testimonies will not be forgiven. Justice never discriminates.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: Rather than resorting to such despicable tactics, my advice is to prove the legality of the trial process back then, and let Fortuna stand firm...

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: Anyways, that's all I got to say... I did accept your press conference entrustment but I will not be the defense lawyer for your case. If you want to continue this conversation, you'll need to pay me more.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: The press conference has ended, and this is the current situation. Accept this failure.

steps.speaker: Staff Member
steps.content: If we don't end well, neither will you!
The staff member raises his fist menacingly, it looks like he's about to take a swing at Mr. Fox. You quickly pull out a small notebook from your pocket.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Mr. Fox, could I interview you again? I have more questions.
The staff member thinks you're a reporter. Afraid of their actions being discovered by the press, they hurriedly leave with an awkward expression.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: You... you're not a reporter, are you? Whoever you are, please take my business card. Thank you very much for helping me just now.
Mr. Fox hands you a piece of paper that seems to have been cut by someone.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: If you ever need a lawyer in the future, please contact me... I may not always win, but I will do my best to serve justice.

steps.speaker: Mr. Fox
steps.content: I have another important defense entrustment to prepare for. Miss Luvia's case is one that needs justice, I must prepare thoroughly. Goodbye for now.
Mr. Fox turns around and leaves energetically, rushing off to his next battlefield.
